title: refactor(queue): optimize batch item processing
description: Processes input batch list items and returns uppercase transformed entries.

ground_truth.description: IndexError due to off-by-one boundary condition in range loop traversal.
ground_truth.explanation: Traversing range(len(items) + 1) attempts to index items[len(items)], which raises an uncaught IndexError.

expected_evidence.description: Index range exceeds valid collection bounds.
